description:
A Flutter LLM Chat Client. Support Android & iOS & Harmony Next.

A Flutter LLM Chat Client. Support Android & iOS & Harmony Next.
✨ Features
- 🎨 Modern Design - Material You design language with dynamic color theming support (Android 12+).
- 🌙 Dark Mode - Perfectly adapted dark theme to protect your eyes.
- 🌍 Multi-language Support - Supports both English and Chinese interfaces.
- 🖥️ Multi-platform Support - Mobile (Android/iOS/Harmony) and Desktop (Windows/macOS/Linux).
- 🔄 Multi-provider Support - Supports major AI providers like OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, etc.
- 🤖 Custom Assistants - Create and manage personalized AI assistants.
- 🖼️ Multimodal Input - Supports various formats including images, text documents, PDFs, Word documents, etc.
- 📝 Markdown Rendering - Full support for code highlighting, LaTeX formulas, tables, and more.
- 🎙️ Voice/TTS Providers - Built-in system TTS plus OpenAI / Google Gemini / ElevenLabs voice servers.
- 🛠️ MCP Support - Model Context Protocol tool integration.
- 🧰 Built-in MCP Tools - Includes a built-in MCP Fetch tool.
- 🔍 Web Search - Integrated with multiple search engines (Exa, Tavily, Zhipu, LinkUp, Brave, Bing, Metaso, SearXNG, Ollama, Jina, Perplexity, Bocha).
- 🧩 Prompt Variables - Supports dynamic variables like model name, time, etc.
- 📤 QR Code Sharing - Export and import provider configurations via QR codes.
- 💾 Data Backup - Supports chat history backup and restoration.
- 🌐 Custom Requests - Supports custom HTTP request headers and bodies.
- 🔡 Custom Fonts - Bring your own fonts (system fonts / Google Fonts).
- ⚙️ Android Background Generation - Keep chat generation running in the background (optional setting).
What's Changed
- feat: Add device-local assistant tools on iOS (weather, location, reminders, and HealthKit with per-type selection), plus a native translation selection action.
- feat: Add Claude web fetch and code execution server tools, bringing generated files into the chat and keeping the container across rounds.
- feat: Add per-conversation model overrides, and default title/suggestion models to the current chat model.
- feat: Add local database snapshots and more resilient backups, with detailed failure reports on the recovery screen.
- feat: Add AnySearch, Parallel, and You.com search providers, plus Brave LLM Context mode.
- feat: Add optional exponential-backoff auto-retry for failed API requests.
- feat: Let kelivo_fetch POST to user-supplied APIs.
- feat: Let users rewrite built-in tool schema descriptions.
- feat: Add a setting for fit-content assistant bubble width.
- feat: Add an option to split assistant replies into per-paragraph bubbles.
- feat: Add an optional surface ladder so cards sit above a sunk page.
- feat: Drop thinking/tool cards on assistant edit by default, with a setting to keep them.
- feat: Store Gemini thought signatures as provider artifacts instead of in message text.
- fix: Unlock the composer send button after switching conversations, so messages can be sent in parallel across chats.
- fix: Stop MCP Streamable HTTP GET 404 reconnect storms.
- fix: Route every Gemini 3.x model through thinkingLevel.
- fix: Echo DeepSeek reasoning on tool continuations.
- fix: Bound tool-image decode and persist MCP results as Markdown.
- fix: Improve CJK font fallback in math rendering.
- fix: Fix several other known bugs and UI issues.
Full Changelog: https://github.com/Chevey339/kelivo/compare/v1.2.4...v1.2.5
